# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser canvas game called `Starter Trail: Element Dex Rally`. Preserve the source mechanics: a player avatar moves horizontally by drag/touch near the bottom of the screen while objects fall from the top; colliding with rewards increases score, colliding with recruitable creatures adds a follower, colliding with hazards removes lives, and zero lives opens a restart modal. Use the creature-collector framing: Bond XP, Squad count, Resolve lives, elemental motes, tiny companion monsters, Dex scan stars, rival traps, and score-based starter evolution. The visual style should be bright, playful, coming-of-age adventure: tall grass route, path markings, sticker HUD, rounded monster silhouettes, elemental icons, and mobile-readable controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a browser-native single-canvas falling-object collector. The player controls a rookie trainer horizontally by pointer/touch drag near the lower playfield. Objects fall from the top at a spawn rate that accelerates with score. Collision with motes adds 100 Bond XP, collision with recruitable creatures adds 500 XP and a following team member, collision with a scan star adds 1000 XP plus flash feedback, and collision with rival hazards removes one life. At zero lives, the modal game-over state appears; the restart button resets score, lives, items, team, evolution, background stage, and play state.

## Protected mechanics
- Horizontal drag/touch/click target movement and smoothing.
- Spawn probabilities, falling-object loop, speed scaling, and offscreen cleanup.
- Circular collision checks against the trainer position.
- Score semantics: mote 100, creature 500, scan 1000.
- Team follower count and follower motion.
- Lives decrement and game-over modal at zero lives.
- Restart flow and audio unlock on user gesture.

## Rebuilt target
`Starter Trail: Element Dex Rally` reframes the same collector loop as a portrait-first creature-collector route sprint: collect elemental motes, recruit tiny companions, dodge rival traps, charge starter evolution, and build a squad. The surface is still a single inline `index.html` using vanilla JS, CSS, canvas, and approved catalog audio/fonts.
